briefdescription.para: Get the process's identifier.
Get the process's page size.

detaileddescription.para: This may fail if the underlying syscall returns an error. In most cases, page size information is used for optimization, and this error can be safely discarded by calling consumeError, and an estimated page size substituted instead.

briefdescription.para: Get the process's estimated page size.

detaileddescription.para: This function always succeeds, but if the underlying syscall to determine the page size fails then this will silently return an estimated page size. The estimated page size is guaranteed to be a power of 2.

briefdescription.para: Return process memory usage.

detaileddescription.para: This static function will return the total amount of memory allocated by the process. This only counts the memory allocated via the malloc, calloc and realloc functions and includes any "free" holes in the allocated space.

briefdescription.para: This static function will set user_time to the amount of CPU time spent in user (non-kernel) mode and sys_time to the amount of CPU time spent in system (kernel) mode.

detaileddescription.para:
If the operating system does not support collection of these metrics, a zero duration will be for both values.
elapsed
Returns the system_clock::now() giving current time
user_time
Returns the current amount of user time for the process
sys_time
Returns the current amount of system time for the process

briefdescription.para: This function makes the necessary calls to the operating system to prevent core files or any other kind of large memory dumps that can occur when a program fails.
true if PreventCoreFiles has been called, false otherwise.

memberdef.argsstring: (StringRef EnvName, StringRef FileName, ArrayRef< std::string > IgnoreList, char Separator=EnvPathSeparator)
memberdef.name: FindInEnvPath

briefdescription.para: This function searches for an existing file in the list of directories in a PATH like environment variable, and returns the first file found, according to the order of the entries in the PATH like environment variable.

detaileddescription.para: If an ignore list is specified, then any folder which is in the PATH like environment variable but is also in IgnoreList is not considered.

briefdescription.para: This function determines if the standard input is connected directly to a user's input (keyboard probably), rather than coming from a file or pipe.
This function determines if the standard output is connected to a "tty" or "console" window.

detaileddescription.para: That is, the output would be displayed to the user rather than being put on a pipe or stored in a file.

briefdescription.para: This function determines if the standard error is connected to a "tty" or "console" window.

detaileddescription.para: That is, the output would be displayed to the user rather than being put on a pipe or stored in a file.

briefdescription.para: This function determines if the given file descriptor is connected to a "tty" or "console" window.

detaileddescription.para: That is, the output would be displayed to the user rather than being put on a pipe or stored in a file.

briefdescription.para: This function determines if the given file descriptor is displayd and supports colors.
This function determines the number of columns in the window if standard output is connected to a "tty" or "console" window.

detaileddescription.para: If standard output is not connected to a tty or console, or if the number of columns cannot be determined, this routine returns zero.

briefdescription.para: This function determines the number of columns in the window if standard error is connected to a "tty" or "console" window.

detaileddescription.para: If standard error is not connected to a tty or console, or if the number of columns cannot be determined, this routine returns zero.

briefdescription.para: This function determines whether the terminal connected to standard output supports colors.

detaileddescription.para: If standard output is not connected to a terminal, this function returns false.

briefdescription.para: This function determines whether the terminal connected to standard error supports colors.

detaileddescription.para: If standard error is not connected to a terminal, this function returns false.

briefdescription.para: Enables or disables whether ANSI escape sequences are used to output colors.

detaileddescription.para: This only has an effect on Windows. Note: Setting this option is not thread-safe and should only be done during initialization.

briefdescription.para: Whether changing colors requires the output to be flushed.

detaileddescription.para: This is needed on systems that don't support escape sequences for changing colors.

briefdescription.para: This function returns the colorcode escape sequences.

detaileddescription.para: If ColorNeedsFlush() is true then this function will change the colors and return an empty escape sequence. In that case it is the responsibility of the client to flush the output stream prior to calling this function.

briefdescription.para: Same as OutputColor, but only enables the bold attribute.
This function returns the escape sequence to reverse forground and background colors.
Resets the terminals colors, or returns an escape sequence to do so.
Get the result of a process wide random number generator.

detaileddescription.para: The generator will be automatically seeded in non-deterministic fashion.

briefdescription.para: Equivalent to ::exit(), except when running inside a CrashRecoveryContext.

detaileddescription.para:
In that case, the control flow will resume after RunSafely(), like for a crash, rather than exiting the current process. Use
NoCleanup for calling _exit() instead of exit().

briefdescription.para: A collection of legacy interfaces for querying information about the current executing process.
